text:
Hey!
Nice to meet you again.
zh:
嘿！
又见面啦。

text: What do you need?
zh: 你需要什么？

text: Tell me about this area.
zh: 跟我讲讲这一带吧。

text: What do you think about Balder?
zh: 你觉得巴尔德怎么样？

text: What do you know about Goran?
zh: 你对戈兰了解多少？

text: Do you have something to sell?
zh: 你有东西卖吗？

text: Is there a place to rest?
zh: 有地方可以休息吗？

text: Themir mentioned, that you can brew potions.
zh: 塞米尔提到你会调配药水。

text: Let's brew some potions.
zh: 我们来调配药水吧。

text: See you!
zh: 回头见！

text: Try to stay alive, honey!
zh: 好好活着，亲爱的！

text: A few things, sure!
zh: 当然有，就几样东西！

text: You are in the #text.frames=4##text.color=highlight#Old Forest#text.default#, which is west of the capital.
zh: 你现在在#text.frames=4##text.color=highlight#古老森林#text.default#，就在王都的西边。

text: This is our outlaw camp. #text.frames=4##text.color=highlight#Balder#text.default# is the chief of these guys.
zh: 这里是我们的法外之徒营地。#text.frames=4##text.color=highlight#巴尔德#text.default#是这帮家伙的头儿。

text: To the north there's another camp, but it is full of bandits and idiots. Guess those two go hand in hand however.
zh: 北边还有一个营地，不过那里全是强盗和蠢货。话说回来，这两样本来就是一路货。

text: And east of here a small river is separating us and the capital.
zh: 东边有条小河，把我们和王都隔开了。

text: Is there anything else you want to know?
zh: 你还想知道点什么吗？

text: He is my fiance, so only the best.
zh: 他是我的未婚夫，自然是没得说。

text: We met a long time ago, but it was only recently he asked me.
zh: 我们很久以前就认识了，但他最近才向我求婚。

text: Ever since then, I am by his side and try to help where I can.
zh: 从那以后，我就一直陪在他身边，尽力帮忙。

text: There's still a place in the barn.
zh: 谷仓里还有个空位。

text: For you it will be 10 gold, as you do not belong to our camp.
zh: 你不是我们营地的人，所以要收你10金币。

text: You are free to sleep there at any time.
zh: 你随时都可以去那儿睡。

text: That's fine. (10 gold)
Maybe later.
zh: 以后再说吧。

text: I'll go to sleep for a while.
zh: 我去睡一会儿。

text: Maybe later.
zh: 以后再说吧。

text: Sure, honey.
zh: 好的，亲爱的。

text: Good night.
zh: 晚安。

text:
Goran?
This ain't an easy story, you know?
zh:
戈兰？
这故事说来话长，你知道吗？

text: Goran is my brother.
zh: 戈兰是我哥哥。

text: Without our parents, we came into the capital at a young age.
zh: 我们从小失去父母，很早就来到了王都。

text:
A man of the royal guard found us and took us with him.
He cared for us.
zh:
一位皇家卫队的人发现了我们，把我们带在身边。
他一直照顾我们。

text: It was there, when we first met Balder, who was a child as well.
zh: 就是在那时，我们第一次遇见了巴尔德，他当时也还是个孩子。

text: Why are you no longer in the capital?
zh: 你们为什么不在王都待了？

text: Who cared for you all?
zh: 是谁照顾你们的？

text: Why did Goran fight Balder?
zh: 戈兰为什么跟巴尔德打起来了？

text: That is all I wanted to know.
zh: 我想知道的就这些。

text:
Sure!
Thank you for listening to my tale.
zh:
好！
谢谢你听我讲这些往事。

text:
Balder wanted to leave the capital for good.
God knows why...
zh:
巴尔德想永远离开王都。
天知道为什么……

text: He even was one of the Royal Guards, the king's elite.
zh: 他甚至曾是皇家卫队的一员，那可是国王的精锐。

text: His name was Gunthar.
zh: 他叫贡塔尔。

text:
Our foster father once was one of the friendliest men in the capital.
He cared for so many children, who lost their family.
zh:
我们的养父曾是王都里最和善的人之一。
他照顾过许许多多失去家人的孩子。

text: But after the assassination of King Weynard II, he had to leave the capital.
zh: 但在韦纳德二世国王遇刺之后，他不得不离开王都。

text: Soon after, we were on our own once again.
zh: 没过多久，我们就又只剩自己了。

text: Balder and Goran led the camp together.
zh: 巴尔德和戈兰曾一起领导营地。

text: But Goran had different plans, as far as I know, so they had an argument.
zh: 但据我所知，戈兰有别的打算，于是他们大吵了一架。

text: Balder left the camp of his own accord.
zh: 巴尔德是自己主动离开营地的。

text: But my brother told everyone, he kicked Balders ass, which is nonsense.
zh: 可我哥哥却跟所有人说是他把巴尔德揍跑的，纯属胡扯。

text: And now we are hunted by the same men.
zh: 而如今，追捕我们的是同一批人。

text:
Hey!
I'm not supposed to talk to you until you pay your fine to Balder.
zh:
嘿！
在你向巴尔德付清罚金之前，我可不能和你说话。

text: I heard you cleared the mine.
zh: 听说你把矿井清理干净了。

text: Impressive, honey!
zh: 真了不起，亲爱的！

text:
Oh... Basically, Themir is right.
However, I'm still a bit inexperienced when it comes to brewing potions.
zh:
哦……塞米尔说得没错。
不过说到调配药水，我还有点生疏。

text: I do have a suggestion, though. Bring me the ingredients and the simple recipes, and I'll try brewing your potions.
zh: 不过我有个提议。把材料和简单的配方带给我，我就试着帮你调配药水。

text:
That way, I can practice my alchemy skills, and you'll get your potions.
Sounds good, right?
zh:
这样一来，我能练习炼金术，你也能拿到药水。
听起来不错吧？

text:
Sure!
Show me your recipes.
zh:
没问题！
把你的配方给我看看。
